assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: Digest files exist for all 8 tasks (task-1-digest.md through task-8-digest.md), but none contains a valid SHA-256 hash. Each digest file contains the placeholder text '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<digest-would-be-computed-after-refetching-from-jira>' instead of 64 lowercase hex characters. The assertion requires 'exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by sha256-md:' but the text after the prefix is '<digest-would-be-computed-after-refetching-from-jira>', not a hex hash.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Impact-map.md states: '"priority": {"name": "Major"}' in the additional_fields JSON and explains 'priority: Inherited from Feature TC-9001 (Major). Feature priority is set and not "Undefined", so it is propagated.' Summary-comment.md confirms: 'Priority: Major (inherited from Feature TC-9001, propagated to all tasks)'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Impact-map.md states: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]' in the additional_fields JSON and explains 'fixVersions: Inherited from Feature TC-9001 (RHTPA 1.5.0). Feature has a non-empty fixVersions array. No fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults, so the default "both" applies — fixVersions are propagated to tasks.' Summary-comment.md confirms: 'Fix Version: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9001, propagated to all tasks; no fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults, default "both" applied)'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists at /tmp/plan-feature-eval-baseline/eval-1/outputs/summary-comment.md and contains an 'Inherited Field Values' section: 'Priority: Major (inherited from Feature TC-9001, propagated to all tasks)' and 'Fix Version: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited from Feature TC-9001, propagated to all tasks; no fixVersion scope setting exists in Jira Field Defaults, default "both" applied)'.
